goal_success: existing world XY distance only; closest_node==last is separately logged
input_preservation: original raw and reference manifest hashes checked before/after; all new paths exclusive
gpu_equivalence: same stored RGB history, selected goal condition, initial noise and DDPM seed; compare existing native.infer and the selected-condition decoder before navigation
stability_observation: report applied command sign reversals and selected-world-point revisions for boundary world X in [1.0,2.0] or [2.5,3.6]; descriptive only, no native equal-index correspondence claim
scope: static topomap localization/subgoal adapter only; no graph, smoothing, recovery, reranking, dynamic experiment, video or GUI replay
